design.sampling: multinomial(n; pi_a, pi_b, pi_c, pi_d) with pi_b=(disc+delta)/2, pi_c=(disc-delta)/2, pi_a=pi_d=(1-disc)/2
design.kappa_ver: closed form (kappa_ver_fast == kappa_ver_closed == BFS, verified in S1 and in the fast-form check)

outputs.grid_note: kappa_ver = -1 would denote infinity (never occurs for n >= 10)

spearman_within_n_observed_m_strata.note: at fixed (n, m) both p and kappa_ver are deterministic functions of the majority: p decreases in it throughout, kappa_ver decreases towards the significance boundary (non-significant side) and increases away from it (significant side), so a stratum's Spearman mixes a positive and a negative branch; the band structure in the figure comes from pooling across m
